description:
Complete the NVENC FFI bring-up so configure → push_frame → drain works end-to-end. Picks up where Rounds 1–4 (2026-05-19) stopped per Option B; the probe layer is fixed and `encoder.selected` is unblocked, but `nvenc_one_frame_shm_encode_produces_fmp4_fragment` still returns `Runtime("nvenc-init-failed:12")` (`NV_ENC_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_PARAM`).

Scope:
1. Resolve the SDK-target contradiction surfaced in 2026-05-19 stop-report-4: confirm target is SDK 12.1 (matches `helper/src/encoder/backends/nvenc/ffi.rs:1` file comment) vs SDK 13.0 (which would add `splitEncodeMode`, `enableReconFrameOutput`, `enableOutputStats` to the bit field and `numStateBuffers`/`outputStatsLevel` after the ME-hints array). Driver 595.71.05 supports both. Lock the choice in a const or comment.
2. Set `init_params.tuningInfo` to a real `NV_ENC_TUNING_INFO` value in `configure()`. Product decision: HIGH_QUALITY=1 vs LOW_LATENCY=2 vs ULTRA_LOW_LATENCY=3. Screen-capture workloads typically want LOW_LATENCY.
3. Set `init_params.bufferFormat` (and any other required encode-config fields) for the chosen preset.
4. Audit `NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS` (helper/src/encoder/backends/nvenc/mod.rs ~172-198): bit-field packing of `reservedBitFields` / `reservedBitFields2`, `codecPicParams` size, `meHintCountsPerBlock` / `meHintRefPicDist` correctness, `reserved3` length vs SDK 12.1 reference size.
5. Audit `NV_ENC_LOCK_BITSTREAM`: field layout, `bitstreamBufferPtr` semantics, `frameAvgQP` / `frameSatd` / bit-field offsets.
6. Audit `NV_ENC_CREATE_INPUT_BUFFER`, `NV_ENC_CREATE_BITSTREAM_BUFFER`, `NV_ENC_LOCK_INPUT_BUFFER` for the same dev-style divergence pattern Round 4 corrected in INITIALIZE_PARAMS.
7. Add `const _: () = assert!(std::mem::size_of::<NV_ENC_INITIALIZE_PARAMS>() == EXPECTED);` (and equivalents for the other structs) so a wrong-size regression cannot ship.
8. Make `nvenc_one_frame_shm_encode_produces_fmp4_fragment` pass under `cargo test -p cove-replay-engine -- --test-threads=1`.
9. Optional / nice-to-have:
   - Fix the pre-existing parallel-test env-var race in helper/tests/encoder_selection.rs (`COVE_NVENC_FORCE_UNAVAILABLE` mutated by two tests in parallel; currently masked by `--test-threads=1`).
   - Correct the literal `enc_status != 15` in helper/src/encoder/backends/nvenc/mod.rs:758-759, mis-labelled as `NV_ENC_ERR_NEED_MORE_INPUT` (SDK 12.1: NEED_MORE_INPUT=17, INVALID_VERSION=15).

Out of scope: validation/, capture/, segment/, export/, electron/, src/, packaging/, workflows/, Cargo files, VAL-CAP-004 policy.

Verification: full `cargo test -p cove-replay-engine -- --test-threads=1` must pass, including the one-frame encode test. Same npm typecheck/validate:build/build invariants. Strict probe must remain green.

Must land before T-010c smoke/RC; T-010c will hit nvenc-init-failed:12 on first real encode otherwise.

Reference evidence: .story/handovers/2026-05-19-12-iss-002-nvenc-version-fix-stop-report-4.md and the three preceding stop-reports.
title: Full NVENC encode-path FFI cleanup (ISS-004)
